name: Moonrite
detailed_description:
Survive along spirits on a world split in two realms.

Explore a hostile material world filled with wild creatures, resources and challenges. Then cross into a spiritual realm filled with secrets, recruitable spirits, rare materials, and lurking threats. Build a thriving base and recruit allies to overcome the dangers that lie beneath both planes.

Key Features

  • Survive two realms – Explore, fight, and gather in the material plane; unlock rare knowledge and recruit spirits in the spiritual plane.

  • Recruit unique spirits – Each has traits, jobs, moods, and personalities. Bond with them or send them to battle.

  • Build a village with their help – Construct a dreamlike village with the help of spirits who grow, craft, and defend by your side.

  • Explore a beautiful world  – Discover dungeons, defeat bosses, and expand your reach across evolving biomes.

  • Online Co-Op – Thrive alone or bring friends into a shared world.

The two realms aren't just visual layers—they’re interdependent ecosystems. Spiritual knowledge and material survival are tightly linked—progress in one realm unlocks new possibilities in the other. Want to build the perfect village? Maximize spirit synergy? Crush every boss with style? The game rewards curiosity and replay, letting you take new paths, discover new builds, and overcome evolving challenges in both worlds.

short_description: Survive a whimsical but brutal world split into a spiritual and a material realms. Gather, craft, and build your village with the help of quirky spirits in this survival game inspired by Ghibli’s movies. Explore and uncover ancient secrets solo or with friends in online co-op to conquer both realms.
